text:
marie: Quick heads-up — PR #8451 (alloc-shim scheduling tweak) is showing a persistent ~8% p95 latency bump on the longseq canary. microbench artifacts attached. need quick eyes before the merge window closes.

aj: link to the bench artifacts? is this only canary or seen in prod sims?

marie: https://bench.internal/runs/8451 (canary runs) + flame graph: https://bench.internal/artifacts/8451/flame.svg
This is from the canary fleet (not prod). p50 is unchanged, p95 shifted.

bench-bot: Canary run summary (id: canary-8451-2026-03-17):
```
model: redwood-4k-quant
workload: longseq-batch4
before: p95=112.3ms, p50=12.9ms, mem_p95=1.42GB
after:  p95=121.4ms, p50=13.1ms, mem_p95=1.48GB
delta: p95 +8.1%, mem_p95 +60MB
```

sam: Is the regression correlated with specific seq lengths or batch sizes?

marie: Reproducible for seq >= 2048 and batch >= 4. Small-batch (batch=1/2) doesn't show it. Also visible with the nightly model build (so not a model binary mismatch).

lee: Any heap/alloc traces? could be transient allocations in the scheduler or an unexpected slice copy.

marie: Heap profiles point at scheduler.go: allocatePrefetchSlots() — we see a spike in short-lived allocations per request. snippet from profiler: 
```
# allocs (top)
0.27s  scheduler.go:142 allocatePrefetchSlots()
0.15s  kvcache/shard.go:87 copyShardMeta()
```

ciara: Can we hold the merge? Ops/Release wants merge blocked until we understand tail. If there's a memory delta we need artifact retention for longer.

aj: I'll take a quick look. If it's just transient alloc churn and we can gate the tweak behind a flag, we can merge safely. Can you post the exact bench command so I can reproduce?

marie: repro command: `./bench_runner --workload longseq --batch 4 --seq 4096 --run-id canary-8451`

bench-bot: Additional artifacts uploaded: `canary-8451/profiles/heap.pb.gz`, `canary-8451/trace/trace.json`, `canary-8451/bench.log`

sam: I'd be comfortable giving a conditional +1 if: (a) we gate the scheduling tweak behind an opt-in flag, and (b) the next canary run shows <=2% p95 delta.

lee: I can hack a quick change to avoid the extra slice allocation (cheap patch) and open a follow-up PR. if marie can re-run canary with that patch we can compare.

marie: Thanks — plan: hold merge, lee opens patch PR, I'll re-run the canary and attach new numbers. Requesting two runtime lead approvals before unblocking: @aj @sam. Holding merge for 2 hours to give time for a quick canary. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

aj: I'll look in the next 30m.

sam: same, ping me when new canary is up and I'll re-check the delta.

lee: opening PR now (PR #8460) with minimal allocation fix, small unit tests included.

marie: awesome — I'll trigger canary when #8460 is merged to my branch and post results here.

ciara: marking this thread as merge-held and notifying release. thanks folks. :white_check_mark:
